rows.quote: Associations of the cis-pQTL variants with prostate cancer were studied in summary-level statistics of genome-wide association studies (GWASs) from the Prostate Cancer Association Group to Investigate Cancer Associated Alterations in the Genome (PRACTICAL) consortium and FinnGen Release 8 [16, 17].
rows.coder_note: Step 2, rules A and I2: this row's own passages give the FinnGen name alone; the sentence given under the PRACTICAL row (outcome_2, p001) names this row's dataset as 'FinnGen Release 8', which is FinnGen R8 in another written form. No other release or conflicting identifier in any passage (step 1 does not apply).

rows.quote: In the primary analyses, we obtained the summary-level GWAS data of prostate cancer from the PRACTICAL study, which is a meta-analysis of 52 GWAS studies enrolling 79,148 prostate cancer patients and 61,106 controls from European ancestry (Table 1) [16].
rows.reference_quote: Schumacher FR Al Olama AA Berndt SI Benlloch S Ahmed M Saunders EJ Dadaev T Leongamornlert D Anokian E Cieza-Borrella C Association analyses of more than 140,000 men identify 63 new prostate cancer susceptibility loci Nat Genet 2018 50 7 928 936 10.1038/s41588-018-0142-8 29892016 PMC6568012
rows.coder_note: Step 2, rule C5: the sentence attributes the PRACTICAL summary data to reference 16, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0142-8 (PMID 29892016) is the source identifier of exactly one outcome row. Rule C4, third case: the Table 1 accession ieu-b-85 is listed by no dictionary row by prefix, range or identifier; under C5 an unlisted accession identifies no other row and is not a conflict. The counts 79,148/61,106 equal no other row's release N (rule H), so step 1 does not apply.
